description: This file defines a ListActivity named List16 demonstrating multi-choice selection mode with contextual actions via ActionMode, utilizing a custom callback class and referencing resources such as menus and string arrays.

classes.name: List16
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating multi-choice list with contextual action mode.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView with multiple choice mode and adapter.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Sets subtitle of the action bar.

inner_classes.name: ModeCallback
inner_classes.description: Handles contextual action mode callbacks for multi-choice ListView.

methods.name: onCreateActionMode
methods.description: Inflates menu and sets title for action mode.

methods.name: onPrepareActionMode
methods.description: Prepares the action mode, returns true.

methods.name: onActionItemClicked
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks in action mode, e.g., sharing or other actions.

methods.name: onDestroyActionMode
methods.description: Handles cleanup when action mode is destroyed.

methods.name: onItemCheckedStateChanged
methods.description: Updates subtitle based on number of selected items.

methods.name: setListAdapter
methods.description: Sets the list adapter using Cheeses.sCheeseStrings array.
